articles.title: How to Add AI to Your Existing Software (Without a Rebuild)
articles.excerpt: Originally published on the SharpQuest blog, written by Piyush Bhatt. Key takeaways You can add AI to the software you already run. It connects through APIs or a small amount of new code; nothing gets…
articles.body: Originally published on the SharpQuest blog , written by Piyush Bhatt. Key takeaways You can add AI to the software you already run. It connects through APIs or a small amount of new code; nothing gets replaced. Start with one task that takes a lot of manual work, such as reading documents, answering questions from your own files or drafting replies. Run a pilot on your own data first. A focused pilot takes 2 weeks or more; a full integration 8 weeks or more, depending on scope. Keep a person in the loop: the AI handles the routine cases and sends anything it isn't sure about to a reviewer. Your data doesn't have to leave your control. With Azure OpenAI your data is not used to train the models, and it can run in your own Azure subscription.

articles.title: Designing call outcomes that lead to the right CRM follow-up
articles.excerpt: A completed call does not tell a sales or service team what to do next. “Ended” is a telephony event. “Booked,” “needs a callback,” and “wrong number” are human outcomes. If a CRM treats these as the…
articles.body: A completed call does not tell a sales or service team what to do next. “Ended” is a telephony event. “Booked,” “needs a callback,” and “wrong number” are human outcomes. If a CRM treats these as the same field, reports become hard to trust and follow-up tasks get assigned inconsistently. Separate the event from the disposition Store the call event with a stable call ID, contact ID when known, direction, start and end times, and the representative who handled it. Then record a disposition chosen after the call. This keeps a dropped call from being labeled “no answer” just because nobody entered a result. A missing disposition should be visible as missing data, not silently converted into a business outcome.

articles.title: Four 1-Star Fiverr Reviews Vanished From Trustpilot Between My Reads. All Four Authors Had Just Posted Again
articles.excerpt: I run a visa agency in Bali, and in the evenings I build scrapers on Apify. One of them reads Trustpilot: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper & API. You give it a domain, it returns the company's TrustScore ro…
articles.body: I run a visa agency in Bali, and in the evenings I build scrapers on Apify. One of them reads Trustpilot: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper & API . You give it a domain, it returns the company's TrustScore row and its reviews, newest first. Its health check is boring on purpose: the newest English reviews of slack.com and fiverr.com , the same input every time. Between 6 and 22 November that check ran fifteen times, thirteen of them with Fiverr in the input, and I kept every dataset. I lined them up to see how much a review feed moves in two weeks. Mostly it grows. But four Fiverr reviews that I had already collected were gone from later reads, even though they were newer than the oldest review those later reads returned. They hadn't slid off the end. They had dropped out of the middle.
articles.author: Matvey

articles.title: A rollout checklist for texting from an existing business landline
articles.excerpt: A business may want customers to text the same number they already call. Before enabling SMS on a landline or VoIP number, map the voice path and the text path separately. The voice provider can conti…
articles.body: A business may want customers to text the same number they already call. Before enabling SMS on a landline or VoIP number, map the voice path and the text path separately. The voice provider can continue handling calls while a hosted-SMS provider handles messages. Treat this as a routing change with a rollback plan, not just a switch in a dashboard. 1. Check what kind of number you have Record the number, its current voice provider, who owns the account, and whether it is a landline, VoIP, or mobile number. Hosted SMS for an existing number commonly applies to landline or VoIP lines, not mobile lines. Do not assume eligibility from the area code or the device that rings. Confirm it with the provider before scheduling any customer announcement. 2.

articles.excerpt: Neutron stars are the ultra-dense, city-sized leftovers of dead stars. When they collide, they can release a brief flash of light called a kilonova. These immensely powerful events forge much of the u…
articles.body: Explore This Section Science Citizen Science Amateur Astronomer? Be a… Overview Resources Opportunities Citizen Science Highlights About Science Activation Neutron stars are the ultra-dense, city-sized leftovers of dead stars. When they collide, they can release a brief flash of light called a kilonova . These immensely powerful events forge much of the universe’s gold, platinum and other heavy elements. Since a kilonova fades within days, astronomers have to find it fast, and no single observatory can watch the whole sky. But if you have a telescope with a camera, or access to one, you can help find and follow these cosmic fireworks as a part of NASA’s Kilonova Catcher project! Kilonova Catcher connects amateur astronomers around the world into a rapid-response network.

articles.excerpt: NASA’s Northrop Grumman Commercial Resupply Services 25 mission, or Northrop Grumman CRS-25, will deliver about 11,000 pounds of science and supplies to the International Space Station. The mission wi…
articles.body: NASA’s Northrop Grumman Commercial Resupply Services 25 mission, or Northrop Grumman CRS-25, will deliver about 11,000 pounds of science and supplies to the International Space Station. The mission will be the third flight of the company’s Cygnus XL, the larger, more cargo-capable version of the company’s solar-powered spacecraft. The Cygnus XL will launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. Following arrival to the station, astronauts aboard the space station will use the Canadarm2 to grapple the spacecraft before ground controllers robotically install it to the Unity module’s Earth-facing port for cargo unloading.

articles.title: 1st-ever detection of a dying star's 'final nuclear heartbeat' challenges what we know about our sun's eventual death
articles.excerpt: Astronomers have caught a rare transitional phase at the end of a star's life, a fossilized remnant of stellar death throes, that could change our picture of the sun's final days.
articles.body: As ubiquitous as the sun is to us today, our star is not eternal; one day, albeit in billions of years, it will die. While massive stars die in supernova explosions, the sun and stars of similar mass die quieter deaths. But that doesn't mean these stars completely go out with a whimper. New observations collected using the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), the world's largest radio telescope comprised of 66 antennas in northern Chile, reveal that the sun's death throes may be different from what scientists had initially believed.

articles.title: Raising the stakes for enterprise networks with AI modernization
articles.excerpt: Enterprise networks are under severe strain. As companies rush to deploy artificial intelligence, the technology is quickly becoming the biggest source of demand on the network. Now, agentic AI is add…
articles.body: Enterprise networks are under severe strain. As companies rush to deploy artificial intelligence, the technology is quickly becoming the biggest source of demand on the network . Now, agentic AI is adding to the load. Tasks conducted by AI agents generate an estimated 450% more network traffic than the same tasks done by human workers. As AI inference shifts from hyperscale training clouds—the huge centralized data centers where raw AI models ingest vast datasets and learn—to real-time, latency-sensitive applications, the need for on-premises or near-premises infrastructure grows. As a result, the gap between enterprise networks that are ready to support AI and those that are not is widening.
